evidence.browser: WebKit gallery preparation-edge-twelve-sources and preparation-edge-twelve-brief at 1100x700, light and dark: 12 source rows lay out, 200-char source title truncates with ellipsis, chip truncates, provenance line shortened

notes:
Did: long titles now carry the full text in a native title tooltip wherever they truncate: the source row title button (sources-panel), the citation chip (brief-contents), the past-meeting row title (knowledge-picker), the source viewer heading, the manifest popover name and the meeting title input. The brief's provenance line shortens document names over 48 characters with an ellipsis (PROVENANCE_NAME_MAX in briefing-block) and keeps the full line in its title. Before this, a 200-character title wrapped the line into a paragraph. Keyboard reach and reduced motion were already met: the global :focus-visible outline (globals.css) or a focus-visible shadow rings every control, and Spinner skips animate-spin-ring under useReducedMotion. tests/components/preparation-edges.test.tsx (4 tests, 12 documents, 200-character meeting and source titles) checks: tab stops in tree order go Paste < Import < the 12 include toggles in order < Prepare again < the 12 source chips in order; every tab stop has a focus ring (no outline-none without a focus:/focus-visible: class); Stop is reachable and ringed while a run is running; title tooltips and the shortened provenance; the spinner animates normally and not when framer-motion's useReducedMotion is mocked true. Removing the row title or the reduced-motion check fails the matching test (checked by hand). Gallery screens preparation-edge-twelve-sources and preparation-edge-twelve-brief (1100x700, 12 sources, 200-character titles) checked in light and dark.
Learned: WebKit in the gallery does not move Tab focus onto buttons (Safari behaviour), and Alt+Tab focused the title input instead, so a gallery screen cannot show a button focus ring through key presses; the bun test covers focus order. With the toolbar transparent, scrolled content (the 'From past meetings' heading) shows under the 'Today' back button. This was there before E5 and is left alone. peek-inline-transcript light failed once more in the full gate and passed on the rerun.
Assumptions: the tooltip is the native title attribute, not Radix Tooltip. It needs no provider and no test mocks, and the accessible name already carries the full text. A truncated input shows no ellipsis, so the meeting title gets only the title attribute.
